title: ChallengeBundle
description: One arm's evidence bundle, mounted read-only into the challenger. Arm A is the snapshot minus telemetry; Arm B is the complete snapshot. Both derive from a SINGLE collection — see src/elcapitan/collector.py.

telemetry.description: Empty for arm A, always. Arm A is the snapshot MINUS telemetry; an entry here would make the arms differ by less than the experiment's only independent variable.

query.description: Recorded beside its result so a reader can tell what was actually asked.

status.description: THREE states, not two. MEASURED: a storage Transactions window with no activity returns a full grid of points each with total 0.0 — identical in shape to a window that has not finished ingesting. 'The query succeeded' therefore says nothing, and an all-zero window shipped as evidence turns the experiment into A-versus-A with a clean-looking null result.

scoring_valid.description: False when arm B carries any telemetry that is not populated. Such a trial is not a null result — it is a trial that cannot be scored. Arm A is always true: it is supposed to have no telemetry.

stub.description: True when no real agent ran. Separate from scoring_valid, which is about telemetry usability: Arm A is legitimately scoring-valid with no telemetry, so it cannot also carry 'this was a dry run'. Any scorer must exclude these.
